description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveRequestCommentDao data access object within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It contains test cases for searching, saving, and retrieving leave request comments, as well as related leave entities.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDaoTest
